answer_1.quote: we propose a powerful and scalable method for creating high-quality, ultra-detailed image captions

answer_2.quote: CompreCap is a structured benchmark that evaluates detailed image descriptions using a scene graph, focusing on object, attribute, and relationship matching... Caption Length(words), object coverage(%), pixel coverage(%), object score(0∼5), relation score(0∼5)

answer_3.quote: For each caption, we decompose it into a series of atomic factual sentences and use the critic model to generate evaluative comments for each atomic sentence.

answer_4.quote: human quality inspectors compare each test caption with the reference caption and image, evaluating them across three main dimensions: completeness, hallucination, and text quality.
answer_4.guideline: evaluate whether the test captions meet or exceed the quality of the reference captions in these dimensions.
